handoff_instructions: M3-T15 done in one step. Added migration 0016_billable_opportunity_idempotency.sql giving billable_opportunities a fact_key column + unique (organization_id, source_communication_id, fact_key) index, matching 0010's pattern for the other draft tables (it predated 0010 and was missed). Added BillableOpportunity.factKey to the domain type (now extends DraftFact) and rows.ts mapping, a new 'billable_opportunity.write' permission (staff + automated actors), createBillableOpportunityInput/CreateBillableOpportunityInput schema, EVENT_TYPES.billableOpportunityCreated, and a new packages/core/src/services/billable-opportunities.ts::createBillableOpportunity service (same idempotent-insert shape as createDraftJobNote). Wired it into field-capture-drafts.ts: a validated billable_opportunity fact now drafts a real 'open' row (recordId/created) instead of the old placeholder 'deferred' status, which is removed from FieldCaptureFactOutcome; a missing job reference clarifies exactly like the other fact types. The owner-facing side of this is the billable_opportunity row itself (status='open') — decideBillableOpportunity (already built, 0011) is how it gets approved/dismissed, and M3-T17 wires it into /inbox; no separate approval/task row is created here. Updated field-capture.test.ts (billable opportunity now asserted as a real drafted row, not deferred) and added packages/core/test/billable-opportunities.test.ts (idempotent replay, cross-org job rejection, permission denial for field_employee). format/lint/typecheck/test all pass. Next: M3-T16 "Inbound SMS to field capture".
